description: MCP servers for Mint Watchdog development. Config only — no credentials, no tokens, no secrets are stored here. Any token a server needs is configured in Kiro settings on the developer's own machine, never committed.

fetch.note: Public pages only (X public profile, Telegram s-pages, Sourcify, BscScan). No login, no session tokens.

filesystem.note: Scoped to this repo directory only.

github.note: Read-only use in this repo (repo metadata, issues). No push, no PR creation from this config.
